messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert — BlueRidge Insurance (dedicated pool eu-west-1) p99 latency > 5s for 12m. Errors up ~8% and increased tail latency. Auto-page sent to on-call. See https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/blue/blue-ridge-dedicated-pool?orgId=1

sre-alice: Acked. I'm pulling graphs now. p95 also creeping to 1.8s, p99 is 5.4s. Looks like a spike concentrated on tenant br-tenant-42.

oncall-bob: Paging in. I see elevated queue lengths on svc-infer-queue and many short TTL cache misses on KV cache (redis) for that tenant. Suspect KV churn from large context requests.

carla-pm: Customer-facing note: BlueRidge reports increased errors in their UI. They've opened a ticket. Dan (CSM) is on the line. We need ETA for mitigation and keep them updated every 10m.

dan-csm: On call with their infra lead, they confirmed a long-running batch job started ~08:12 UTC hitting our endpoint with long context sequences. They're pausing it now. Will confirm in 2m.

ellie-infra: Quick checks: dedicated pool gw-ew1-ded-7 has CPU/GPU sat, kernel queue growth on runtime nodes, and KV eviction spikes. Heatmap: hot shard on br-tenant-42. Suggest isolating tenant and routing to warm spare.

oncall-bob: Mitigation plan: 1) Isolate br-tenant-42 to a quarantine routing policy (rate limit to 20 RPS) 2) Scale dedicated pool +2 GPUs (gw-ew1-ded-7 -> +2) 3) Failover a subset to eu-west-2 warm pool 4) Apply per-tenant short-term cache TTL bump (increase prefix caching)

sre-alice: Running commands now:
```
# isolate tenant
rwctl routing update --tenant br-tenant-42 --policy quarantine --rate 20
# scale pool
rwctl pool scale --pool gw-ew1-ded-7 --add-gpus 2
# trigger failover for subset
rwctl route migrate --tenant br-tenant-42 --to-region eu-west-2 --percent 30
```

frank-support: Noted. I'll draft a customer message: "We're actively mitigating a latency issue affecting your dedicated pool; brief performance degradation possible while we isolate traffic and shift capacity." Sending once we confirm first step.

incident-bot: Action logs: routing policy updated (ok), pool scale requested (in-progress), migrate job queued. Incident ID: INC-2025-0427-BR.

oncall-bob: Pool scale confirmed +2 GPUs applied to gw-ew1-ded-7, nodes provisioning. Initial p99 improved from 5.4s -> 3.1s for non-quarantined traffic.

ellie-infra: Migration job started. Note: we must watch KV miss rate on eu-west-2; it has smaller cache priming. Will temporarily enable prefix caching for migrated traffic.

sre-alice: After quarantine and scale, tail improved further: p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~2.0s for core traffic. br-tenant-42 still heavy but rate-limited. Continue monitoring for 30m, then plan rollback of isolation if stable.

carla-pm: BlueRidge updated: they paused the batch job and appreciate the quick action. They asked for a timeline for full recovery. Suggest telling them 60-90 minutes to verify warm-spare priming.

dan-csm: Confirmed with their lead — they're leaving batch paused for now. Requesting a postmortem and whether we throttled or evicted keys belonging to them.

oncall-bob: We applied per-tenant rate limit and didn't evict keys aggressively; only adjusted TTL and routing. Capture logs for postmortem:
```
# sample log
[08:24:15] router: tenant=br-tenant-42 action=quarantine rate=20
[08:25:02] pool-scaler: pool=gw-ew1-ded-7 add_gpus=2 status=success
[08:26:10] route-migrator: tenant=br-tenant-42 to=eu-west-2 pct=30 status=start
```

frank-support: Sending status note to the customer now (10:28 UTC). Will ask if they'd like us to resume batch when we confirm stable tail for 30m.

sre-alice: Requesting handoff to next on-call in 20m. Current mitigation: quarantine + scale + 30% migration + prefix caching. We should maintain increased retention in observability for this tenant's traces for 48h.

carla-pm: Agreed. I've scheduled a 1:1 with BlueRidge for 11:00 UTC to review impact. Also creating a follow-up ticket for runbook improvements around dedicated-pool tenant isolation.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-0427-BR status: mitigated -> partial (tail reduced). Next steps: monitor 30m, prepare postmortem doc link https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC-2025-0427-BR.

oncall-bob: Ack handoff. If anything spikes, ping me and escalate to SRE paging. Otherwise I'll log the change details and hand to next on-call.

sre-alice: Thanks all. Summary for postmortem: root cause = large batch job causing KV cache churn and GPU queue pressure; remediation = tenant quarantine + scale + regional migration + cache priming; impact = elevated p99 up to 5.4s for ~12m, partial errors ~8%, customer paused batch.

frank-support: Closing loop with customer: sent timeline and next steps. Will attach mitigations and invite to postmortem. :white_check_mark:
